title: Validating Candidate Congenital Heart Disease Genes in Drosophila
author: Jun-Yi Zhu
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all items listed in the Materials section: 1,250 µl pipette tips (BioExpress, GeneMate, catalog P-1234-1250), 200 µl tips (P-1237-200), 10 µl tips (P-1234-10XL), permanent marker, Fisherbrand plastic Petri dishes (S33580A), microscope slides (VWR 16004-430), 24 × 50 mm gold Seal cover slips (Thermo Fisher 3322), heart‑specific Gal4 driver line 4XHand‑Gal4/Cyo, UAS‑RNAi transgenic strains (Bloomington Drosophila Stock Center), CO₂ source, fly food (Meidi Laboratories), Vaseline (COVIDIEN), Schneider’s Drosophila medium (Thermo Fisher Gibco, catalog 21720001), 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS (Alfa Aesar, catalog J19943), PBS (10×, pH 7.4, GENAXY catalog 40-029), BSA powder (Santa Cruz sc‑2323), Triton X‑100 (Fisher BP151‑100), Alexa Fluor 555 Phalloidin (Thermo Fisher Invitrogen A34055), EC11 anti‑Pericardin primary antibody (DSHB catalog EC11), biotin‑goat anti‑mouse secondary (Vector SP‑1100), Streptavidin‑Cy5 (Thermo Fisher SA1011), VECTASHIELD with DAPI (Vector H‑1200), clear nail polish (Electron Microscopy Science 72180).

steps.title: Set up genetic cross
steps.instruction: Combine 5 male flies homozygous for the UAS‑RNAi transgene with 10‑15 four‑day‑old virgin females of genotype 4XHand‑Gal4/Cyo in a vial and incubate at 25 °C.

steps.title: Maintain crosses and shift temperature
steps.instruction: Transfer the cross to a fresh vial of fly food each day for 5‑6 days while keeping at 25 °C. After each daily egg‑lay, move the emptied vial to 29 °C to boost UAS‑transgene expression. After 5‑6 such vials, allow the developing progeny to remain at 29 °C.

steps.title: Count wing phenotypes and calculate lethality
steps.instruction: When adult progeny emerge (4‑5 days), anesthetize with CO₂ on a fly pad, record numbers of curly‑wing (CyO, no RNAi) and straight‑wing (RNAi expressed in cardioblasts) flies until at least 200 curly‑wing flies are counted. Calculate developmental lethal rate as (Curly − Straight) / Curly × 100 %.

steps.title: Collect straight‑wing adults for survival assay
steps.instruction: Gather at least 60 straight‑wing adult flies (4XHand‑Gal4>UAS‑RNAi) within 1‑2 days, keep them at 29 °C, and place no more than 15 flies per vial. Set up a minimum of 5 crosses (or >10 crosses if the RNAi causes high mortality).

steps.title: Perform adult survival assay
steps.instruction: Begin counting live flies immediately after collection. Record the number of surviving flies every two days and transfer the flies to fresh vials of fly food every two days to avoid wet food. Continue until all flies have died and plot % survival versus time.

steps.title: Prepare adult flies for heart staining
steps.instruction: Anesthetize 6‑10 straight‑wing and 6‑10 curly‑wing adult flies with CO₂, affix each ventral side up in the bottom of a Petri dish using a thin line of Vaseline, label genotype with a permanent marker, remove legs, add ~20 ml Schneider’s medium to submerge flies, cut the ventral abdominal cuticle circumferentially with scissors, pipette the medium up and down 5‑6 times with a P200 set to 200 µl to dislodge viscera, and clear remaining fat body with fine forceps.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize specimens
steps.instruction: Pour out the medium, add fresh Schneider’s medium to wash and discard. Add ~20 ml 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS, fix for 10 min at room temperature, then pour out fixative. Rinse carcasses 3 times with ~20 ml PBS each. Add ~20 ml 2 % BSA in PBS containing 0.1 % Triton X‑100, incubate 30 min at room temperature, then discard.

steps.title: Primary antibody and phalloidin incubation
steps.instruction: Add ~20 ml PBS containing Alexa Fluor 555 Phalloidin (1:1,000 dilution) and EC11 anti‑Pericardin mouse primary antibody (1:500 dilution), incubate overnight at 4 °C in the dark. Remove the dish from the refrigerator and rinse 3 times with PBS at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add ~20 ml PBS, incubate 20 min at room temperature and repeat this wash three times. Then add ~20 ml PBS containing biotin‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse antibody (1:500 dilution), incubate 2 h at room temperature. Rinse 3 times with PBS, add ~20 ml PBS, incubate 20 min at room temperature and repeat three times.

steps.title: Streptavidin labeling
steps.instruction: Add ~20 ml PBS containing Streptavidin‑Cy5 (1:1,000 dilution), incubate 1 h at room temperature. Rinse 3 times with PBS, then add ~20 ml PBS, incubate 20 min at room temperature and repeat three times.

steps.title: Mount specimens for imaging
steps.instruction: Place each heart in ~2 ml VECTASHIELD antifade mounting medium with DAPI on a glass slide, gently lower a 24 × 50 mm gold Seal cover slip using forceps, and seal the edges with clear nail polish.

steps.title: Confocal imaging and analysis
steps.instruction: Image specimens on a Zeiss ApoTome.2 microscope with a 20× Plan‑Apochromat 0.8 NA air objective. Image control samples first, set exposure to ~70 % of saturation, then acquire Z‑stack images of the whole heart for all samples. Export images as TIFF files, process with ImageJ 1.49, select Z‑layers that exclude ventral muscle fibers, and quantify myofibrillar density and pericardin deposition.

steps.title: Prepare 3rd‑instar larvae
steps.instruction: Raise larvae at 29 °C to the third‑instar stage. Select 6‑10 control larvae (GFP‑positive on balancer chromosome) and 6‑10 experimental larvae (GFP‑negative) using fluorescence stereo microscopy. Pin the tail and head of each larva to a Petri dish ventral side up with insect pins, submerge under a drop of Schneider’s medium, make a ventral incision from tail to head with scissors, insert four additional pins to hold the cuticle open, and remove internal organs with No. 5 forceps. Wash the carcass once with Schneider’s medium, then follow steps 8‑13 (fixation through imaging) exactly as described for adult flies.
